company_name: SHENZHEN CHUANGZHI SEMI-LINK TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical metallized interconnect coating materials for electronic packaging, essential for semiconductor device functionality.
summary: Shenzhen Chuangzhi Semi-Link Technology Co., Ltd specializes in metallized interconnect coating materials and process technologies for the electronic packaging industry. Their products are crucial for wafer-level and chip-level packaging, as well as PCB manufacturing, enabling precise conductive paths and functional structures within electronic devices.
capabilities: Metallized interconnect coating materials for electronic packaging
Customized coating services for semiconductor and PCB sectors
Advanced coating material supply chain for wafer-level packaging
Key process technologies for chip-level packaging

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen and employs over 400 staff, indicating a significant presence in the region.
